name: Dr Ruth McNair
title: Dr / GP
description: GP at Northside Clinic, listed in the AusPATH trans health provider directory. Northside Clinic is experienced in supporting trans, gender diverse and non-binary people; its GPs prescribe gender affirming hormones (some using the informed consent model), with nurse education on hormone therapy and testosterone self-injection. Under-18s are usually referred to the RCH Gender Service.
specialties: LGBTQIA health, trans and gender diverse health, general practice

name: Dr Spencer Watts
title: Dr / GP
description: Spencer offers gender-affirming health care, including initiation (for adults) and monitoring (16 years and older) of gender-affirming hormones, using the informed consent model. Committed to culturally safe, inclusive care for patients of all backgrounds and identities; also provides sexual health care, PrEP and Implanon.
specialties: Gender affirming hormone therapy, sexual health, PrEP, contraception, mental health

title: Dr / GP
